title: 'Biologics' as soft-tissue drones in conscious craft

tellings.quote: So the biologics could be something like soft tissue drones.

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he helped recover a UFO, passes on an idea from a man he calls Dave. According to Dave, the so-called biologics, the living bodies said to be found with these craft, might not be pilots at all but soft-tissue drones, tools serving a craft that is itself conscious. If true, it would change what we think is actually flying these things.
